role: Main-actor rule evaluator for live-workout coaching triggers: holds a rule table, per-rule last-fired cooldown map and a capped in-memory event history; WorkoutVoiceCoach feeds it a WorkoutAIContext each recorder tick (with canSpeak false while muted or alerts are off) and speaks only .spoken events.
types: WorkoutTriggerEngine.Event: struct — fired event (ruleID, tier, urgency, message, firedAt)
WorkoutTriggerEngine.Rule: struct — id, tier, urgency, cooldown, condition/message closures, didFire hook (spends one-shot/cooldown state on firing), resetWorkoutState hook
state: private var lastFired: [String: Date] (per-rule cooldown map, in memory)
private(set) var history: [Event] (capped at 200, in memory; no reader anywhere in the repo)
toplevel: Header comment states contracts (real data only, always optional phrasing, silence via cooldown/tier); notes .haptic has no Watch handler and .silent is history-only. The Urgency comment says only user.threshold.breach can be heard; strap-drop is urgent but .haptic.

units.does: Memberwise initialiser for Rule: stores id, tier, urgency (default .routine), cooldown, condition and message closures, the didFire hook (default no-op, run once each time the rule fires) and the resetWorkoutState hook (default no-op closure).
Creates the engine with the given rule list, or the default catalogue built over settingsProvider (default: the app's SettingsManager settings) when nil.

branches.effect: nil: uses the 15-rule default catalogue reading settings through settingsProvider; non-nil: uses the injected list (only WorkoutVoiceCoach.init builds an engine, with the defaults)

units.does: Walks rules in order; for each rule shouldFire runs the condition (always) and checks the cooldown and canSpeak. A firing rule builds an Event with its message, runs its didFire hook, appends the event to the returned array and history, and stamps lastFired[rule.id] = now. Returns fired events in rule order. canSpeak false keeps .spoken rules from firing, so a muted coach doesn't spend their cooldown/state.
calls: closure:Rule.message / Rule.didFire — set by the rule factories in WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift

branches.cond: for rule in rules where shouldFire(...)
branches.effect: every rule is checked (condition evaluated) in catalogue order; only those shouldFire accepts are fired; empty list returns []

units.does: Evaluates the rule's condition first, unconditionally (so streak state follows every reading through cooldowns), then returns false while the rule is inside its cooldown since lastFired; otherwise true when the condition held and the rule is not .spoken or canSpeak is true.
calls: closure:Rule.condition — set by the rule factories in WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift (e.g. alpha1AboveVT2Condition, hrSpikeNoPaceCondition, strapDroppedCondition, dueThresholds)
writes: mem:rule closure streak state via Rule.condition

branches.cond: rule has a lastFired stamp and now - last < cooldown

units.does: Appends an event to history and trims the oldest entries so at most 200 remain.

branches.effect: true: removeFirst(count-200) keeps last 200; false: nothing trimmed

units.does: Clears lastFired and history and calls every rule's resetWorkoutState hook so closure-captured per-workout state starts fresh; called via WorkoutVoiceCoach.reset() at workout start.
calls: closure:Rule.resetWorkoutState — set in +Rules.swift factories (alpha1AboveVT2ResetWorkoutState, hrSpikeNoPaceResetWorkoutState, StrapLinkState.reset, threshold lastSpokenAt.removeAll, readiness fired=false, racePaceModeDetectedResetWorkoutState, periodic lastFiredElapsedSec=nil, recent-load fired=false; others default no-op)

branches.effect: calls each rule's reset hook; stateless rules run the default no-op

units.does: Returns the 15-rule default catalogue in fixed order: effortRules + terrainAndZoneRules + equipmentAndProgressRules + sessionNarrativeRules(settings:), the last reading the periodic check-in's settings through the given provider.
